name: The Dog on Cannery Row
description: A spaniel that will not walk down forty feet of ordinary pavement between a chandler's and a shuttered bakery, and goes the long way round instead. Only rolled if somebody asks.

checks.name: What the animal is actually doing

dc.basis: level 1 standard DC, one step easy — anyone who has kept a dog has seen this behaviour, just not here

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Not fear. Avoidance — the flat refusal a dog gives a closed door. And it is the same forty feet every night, which means whatever it is does not move.
outcomes.success: It is not fear behaviour. No cowering, no tail, no ears. It is avoidance — the same flat refusal a dog gives a closed door.
outcomes.failure: Dogs are strange about places. This one is being strange about this place.

notes: End the session on the man complaining about his dog. No check is needed unless somebody asks for one.
